title: Repeat Repair Labor Allowance by Age and Mileage of the Earlier Repair — Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
**Allowance schedule — Service Accounts and Repair Orders repeat repair estimates.** The repeat allowance follows how recent the earlier repair is.

| Earlier repair's line date, in whole months before the diagnosis | Miles driven since the earlier repair | Labor amount multiplied by |
|---|---|---|
| No more than 24 | No more than 24000 | 0.5 |
| No more than 36, where the first row does not hold | Any | 0.75 |
| More than 36 | Any | not reduced |

**Terms.** The diagnosis is the line date of the latest diagnostic fee on the account. The miles driven since are the odometer on that diagnostic fee less the earlier repair's odometer at check-in. A whole month is complete on the same day of a later month, or on the first day of the month after it where that month has no such day.

**Cases (hypothetical).**
- 22 whole months and 19500 miles — 0.5.
- 22 whole months and 26000 miles — the first row fails on miles, 0.75.
- 31 whole months and 18000 miles — 0.75.
- 37 whole months — not reduced.
